payload.summary: A bold move receives the backing required to become more than a lucky break.
payload.body: A bold move receives the backing required to become more than a lucky break. Mars trine Jupiter can line up effort with opportunity, so staff, money, permits, or public support arrive behind a plan that is already prepared to use them. The work can grow quickly without becoming reckless because the people doing it know where the extra resources belong. This is a good time to scale what has already proven itself. Keep the next step tied to the team and systems that made the first result possible.
